method: Local APK bytecode inspection and existing user-generated capture analysis; no broker requests or trades sent

cash.response_data: List of fund-account rows in USD, HKD and CNY valuation currencies

excluded_fields.cashAmt: Amount converted into the selected valuation currency
excluded_fields.cashBalance: Rendered as Saving Plus balance by this APK
excluded_fields.enableCash: Different broker measure; not the legacy UI cash labels

holdings.quantity_note: Held quantity currentAmount, not available-to-sell enableAmount
holdings.number_encoding: Decimal values serialized as JSON numbers without a floating-point round trip

side.validation: Buy observed in user capture; both codes and their request use proven from APK; sell submission not tested live

order_states.cancel_note: App supports waiting, partially filled, or pending-review orders. isOpen alone does not prove eligibility. The API listener should reconcile pending cancellation instead of blindly resending.

quote.US_capture_observation: All 17 existing US quote observations had delay=true and suspension=1; real-time availability remains unproven
quote.price_note: last is a quote input for optional whole-share notional sizing; it is not an order limit price. Delayed or stale quotes must not be silently treated as current.
